tasks.title: Rewrite validate-phase0-gate.ts — fix broken imports and logic
tasks.description:
MODIFY ONE EXISTING FILE: scripts/scs001/validate-phase0-gate.ts. Replace the entire file contents. Do NOT modify any other file.

The current file is broken at import-time: it imports from three non-existent paths and calls methods that do not exist on DedupLedger. This rewrite fixes all issues per the original spec in sprint-095.json task 095-01.

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. IMPORTS — use EXACTLY these import paths:
   import { SCS001Orchestrator, PipelineRunReport } from '../../agents/scs001-orchestrator/index';
   import { DedupLedger, LedgerEntry } from '../../agents/scs001-orchestrator/dedup-ledger';
   import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync, unlinkSync } from 'fs';
   import { join } from 'path';
   No other imports. No Router import. No shared-types import.

2. DEFINE these two interfaces inline (do NOT import them):
   interface GateCriterion { id: string; name: string; pass: boolean; details: string; }
   interface GateReport { gate: string; date: string; criteria: GateCriterion[]; overall_pass: boolean; recommendation: string; }

3. CHECK 1 — TASK_TARGET Routing (id: 'task-target-routing', name: 'TASK_TARGET Routing to Ollama'):
   a. Read runtime/router.py from join(process.cwd(), 'runtime', 'router.py'). Check if content includes 'localhost:11434'. Store as routerHasOllama: boolean.
   b. Attempt to read routing log at join(process.cwd(), 'logs', 'routing', '2026-03-16.jsonl'). If it exists, split by newline, JSON.parse each non-empty line (skip lines that throw on parse). For each parsed entry, check entry.task_target === 'local' and entry.provider === 'ollama' to increment localOllamaCount; check entry.task_target === 'local' and entry.provider !== 'ollama' to increment localNonOllamaCount.
   c. If localOllamaCount > 0: pass = (localNonOllamaCount === 0). details = 'Routing log: ' + localOllamaCount + ' local->ollama, ' + localNonOllamaCount + ' local->non-ollama'.
   d. If routing log absent OR localOllamaCount === 0: pass = routerHasOllama. details = 'Static check: router.py localhost:11434=' + routerHasOllama + ' (no routing log data)'.
   e. Criterion 1: { id: 'task-target-routing', name: 'TASK_TARGET Routing to Ollama', pass, details }.

4. CHECK 2 — Idempotent Replay / Dedup (id: 'idempotent-replay', name: 'Idempotent Replay — DedupLedger'):
   a. tempLedgerPath = join(process.cwd(), 'workspace', 'scs001', '.gate-test-ledger.jsonl')
   b. const ledger = new DedupLedger(tempLedgerPath)
   c. Create 3 LedgerEntry objects with clip_ids 'gate-test-1','gate-test-2','gate-test-3', video_id=clip_id, published_at=new Date().toISOString(), run_id='gate-test'
   d. ledger.recordPublished(entries3) — writes 3 entries
   e. Create testClips5 = [{clip_id:'gate-test-1'},{clip_id:'gate-test-2'},{clip_id:'gate-test-3'},{clip_id:'gate-test-4'},{clip_id:'gate-test-5'}]
   f. result1 = ledger.filterNewClips(testClips5) — expect length 2
   g. result2 = ledger.filterNewClips(testClips5) — expect length 2 (idempotent)
   h. Record result1 as published: ledger.recordPublished(result1.map(c => ({ clip_id: c.clip_id, video_id: c.clip_id, published_at: new Date().toISOString(), run_id: 'gate-test' })))
   i. result3 = ledger.filterNewClips(testClips5) — expect length 0
   j. Cleanup: in finally block, if (existsSync(tempLedgerPath)) unlinkSync(tempLedgerPath)
   k. pass = (result1.length === 2 && result2.length === 2 && result3.length === 0)
   l. Wrap in try/catch/finally. On catch: pass=false, details='DedupLedger test threw: '+(err as Error).message

5. CHECK 3 — Full Pipeline Dry-Run (id: 'pipeline-dry-run', name: 'Full Pipeline Dry-Run (mock mode)'):
   a. const orchestrator = new SCS001Orchestrator('mock')
   b. const report: PipelineRunReport = await orchestrator.run()
   c. pass = (report.stages.length >= 8 && report.summary.topics_found >= 1 && report.summary.clips_discovered >= 1)
   d. const errorStages = report.stages.filter(s => s.status === 'error').map(s => s.stage)
   e. details = 'Pipeline: ' + report.stages.length + ' stages, ' + report.summary.topics_found + ' topics, ' + report.summary.clips_discovered + ' clips' + (errorStages.length > 0 ? '. Warn: error stages=' + errorStages.join(',') : '')
   f. Wrap in try/catch. On catch: pass=false, details='Pipeline dry-run threw: '+(err as Error).message

6. BUILD GateReport:
   const criteria: GateCriterion[] = [criterion1, criterion2, criterion3];
   const allPass = criteria.every(c => c.pass);
   const gateReport: GateReport = {
     gate: 'phase0-to-phase1',
     date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
     criteria,
     overall_pass: allPass,
     recommendation: allPass ? 'PROCEED to Phase 1 — all gate criteria met. Set SCS_MODE=live in ecosystem.config.js.' : 'BLOCKED — fix failing criteria before advancing to Phase 1.'
   };

7. WRITE gate report:
   const gatesDir = join(process.cwd(), 'workspace', 'gates');
   mkdirSync(gatesDir, { recursive: true });
   writeFileSync(join(gatesDir, 'phase0-phase1-gate.json'), JSON.stringify(gateReport, null, 2));

8. PRINT results:
   criteria.forEach(c => console.log((c.pass ? '\u2713' : '\u2717') + ' [' + c.name + ']: ' + c.details));
   console.log('');
   console.log(allPass ? 'GATE PASS' : 'GATE FAIL');
   console.log('Report written to workspace/gates/phase0-phase1-gate.json');

9. EXIT: process.exit(allPass ? 0 : 1);

10. STRUCTURE: wrap all the above in async function main(): Promise<void> and call main().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });

FAIL CONDITIONS:
(1) Any of the three broken import paths remain (../runtime/router, ../runtime/dedupledger, ../workspace/shared-types)
(2) Any call to ledger.insertClip, ledger.removeClip, or router.processTask — these methods do not exist
(3) GateReport or GateCriterion imported instead of defined inline
(4) process.exit() not called
(5) workspace/gates/phase0-phase1-gate.json not written
(6) Any file other than scripts/scs001/validate-phase0-gate.ts modified
(7) overall_pass field missing from written JSON
(8) Routing log parsed with string-contains ('TASK_TARGET') instead of JSON field access (entry.task_target)
tasks.context: Sprint 095 produced a gate validator approved at 81/100 but with three fatal import errors: (1) imports Router from ../runtime/router — this is Python, no TypeScript export, (2) imports DedupLedger from ../runtime/dedupledger — wrong path, real path is ../../agents/scs001-orchestrator/dedup-ledger, (3) imports GateReport from ../workspace/shared-types — file does not exist. Logic errors: DedupLedger has no insertClip or removeClip methods — real API is recordPublished(entries: LedgerEntry[]) and filterNewClips<T>(clips: T[]): T[]. Router.processTask does not exist — dry-run must use SCS001Orchestrator('mock').run(). Routing log at logs/routing/2026-03-16.jsonl has JSON fields task_target and provider — must be read as JSON, not string-contains. The workspace/gates directory does not exist and must be created with mkdirSync recursive. This task is the sole blocker before Phase 1 live TikTok posting.
